name: generated callbacks retain uncertain publications until their owners release
description: Both caller directions on one real socket, with four exports and imports per scope: seven fresh callback supplies fail busy, followed by remote cancellation and frame-size errors, timeout, cancellation after a delivery barrier, suppressed replies, events and a handler-returned callback whose reply is lost. Every retained callback remains callable after failure, every explicit owner release revokes its remote alias, and every cycle reaches baseline before the next. Pre-cancelled requests and oversized events prove local non-publication unwinds only their new exports. Both generated bindings must serve this scenario without skips.
